v.human: T'aven baxtale, human. You're here to conduct some business? If so, I welcome you to Mettbach Arms and Ammunition. If not, keep right on walking.
v.elf: T'aven baxtale, elf. You're here to conduct some business? If so, I welcome you to Mettbach Arms and Ammunition. If not, keep right on walking.

v.m: I had to meet you in person. To look into your eyes and see the man behind the name. Now that I have done so, I am sure. You are the one that I need.
v.f: I had to meet you in person. To look into your eyes and see the woman behind the name. Now that I have done so, I am sure. You are the one that I need.

v.m: I will iron out the remaining details with your Herr Amsel. He'll want to talk this over with you anyway, I'm sure. You're a good man. You are saving more lives than you know.
v.f: I will iron out the remaining details with your Herr Amsel. He'll want to talk this over with you anyway, I'm sure. You're a good woman. You are saving more lives than you know.

v.m: That was *crazy,* Freund. Bullets flyin', people dropping like flies... *crazy.*
v.f: That was *crazy,* Freundin. Bullets flyin', people dropping like flies... *crazy.*

v.m: One of these days, Freund. Absolutely. But today, you're here for a reason. What can ol' Zaak get for you?
v.f: One of these days, Freundin. Absolutely. But today, you're here for a reason. What can ol' Zaak get for you?

v.m: Guten Tag, Freund. You here for some magic? Because Zaak Flash...
v.f: Guten Tag, Freundin. You here for some magic? Because Zaak Flash...

v.m: Welcome back, Freund. What can ol' Zaak getcha?
v.f: Welcome back, Freundin. What can ol' Zaak getcha?

v.m: This one is dangerous! Kill him!
v.f: This one is dangerous! Kill her!

v.m: This one is dangerous! Kill him!
v.f: This one is dangerous! Kill her!

v.m: Your friend - this outsider - jokes at our Great Master's expense. But we take no offense. His words are like the babble of a newborn babe. He is ignorant of the truth.
v.f: Your friend - this outsider - jokes at our Great Master's expense. But we take no offense. Her words are like the babble of a newborn babe. She is ignorant of the truth.

v.m: If the noise continues, we will educate him, and the babble will cease.
v.f: If the noise continues, we will educate her, and the babble will cease.

v.m: The outsider may do whatever he wishes. We will not interfere with him unless he provokes us. Our Great Master's offer was to you, child. Accept, and everything that you desire will be yours.
v.f: The outsider may do whatever she wishes. We will not interfere with her unless she provokes us. Our Great Master's offer was to you, child. Accept, and everything that you desire will be yours.

v.m: Your friend - this outsider - slanders our Great Master. But we take no offense. His words are like the babble of a newborn babe. He is ignorant of the truth.
v.f: Your friend - this outsider - slanders our Great Master. But we take no offense. Her words are like the babble of a newborn babe. She is ignorant of the truth.

v.m: If the noise continues, we will teach him, and the babble will cease.
v.f: If the noise continues, we will teach her, and the babble will cease.

v.m: Your friend - this outsider - speaks out of turn. But we take no offense. His words are like the babble of a newborn babe. He is ignorant of the truth.
v.f: Your friend - this outsider - speaks out of turn. But we take no offense. Her words are like the babble of a newborn babe. She is ignorant of the truth.

v.m: If the noise continues, we will teach him, and the babble will cease.
v.f: If the noise continues, we will teach her, and the babble will cease.

v.m: There he is. Our hero.
v.f: There she is. Our hero.

v.m: There he is!
v.f: There she is!

v.m: Please, sir... may I speak? I promise you, I will come no closer.
v.f: Please, ma'am... may I speak? I promise you, I will come no closer.

v.m: Thank you, sir. I will be brief.
v.f: Thank you, ma'am. I will be brief.

v.m: We are not monsters, sir. We are people with an illness. Incurable for now, and yet some of us cling to hope. You may think of us as lepers, if you wish.
v.f: We are not monsters, ma'am. We are people with an illness. Incurable for now, and yet some of us cling to hope. You may think of us as lepers, if you wish.

v.m: This is a secure facility, sir. Show your ID or move along.
v.f: This is a secure facility, ma'am. Show your ID or move along.

v.m: All right, tough guy. I get it, you're wiz. Just do me a favor and keep the damn bag closed, okay?
v.f: All right, tough gal. I get it, you're wiz. Just do me a favor and keep the damn bag closed, okay?

v.m: Color me surprised. I'd expect a man of your social strata to rant and rail against a system like the Academy's.
v.f: Color me surprised. I'd expect a woman of your social strata to rant and rail against a system like the Academy's.

v.m: I should say not. You seem like a good man, and I don't mean to insult you. But you know how cutthroat it is out there. Hans will have every advantage, even if I have to mortgage the house to provide it to him.
v.f: I should say not. You seem like a good woman, and I don't mean to insult you. But you know how cutthroat it is out there. Hans will have every advantage, even if I have to mortgage the house to provide it to him.

v.m: You! The guy from the cyberware kiosk! What the hell is going on here?
v.f: You! The gal from the cyberware kiosk! What the hell is going on here?

v.m: Just... just hear me out, guy. This has to get done, but I think... I think that somethin' got Viktor. That's why I need your help.
v.f: Just... just hear me out, gal. This has to get done, but I think... I think that somethin' got Viktor. That's why I need your help.

v.m: I'll be waitin' right here, guy. Let me know what happens.
v.f: I'll be waitin' right here, gal. Let me know what happens.

v.m: "We"? Mein Schatz, either we are in the presence of royalty, or he has decided to keep on.
v.f: "We"? Mein Schatz, either we are in the presence of royalty, or she has decided to keep on.

v.m: I think the Flux may have him, mein Schatz.
v.f: I think the Flux may have her, mein Schatz.

v.m: I remain convinced that you are thoroughly *dishonorable,* shadowrunner. A man of honor would never have allowed his target to live as long as you did. Whatever your motives might have been, honor was not among them.
v.f: I remain convinced that you are thoroughly *dishonorable,* shadowrunner. A woman of honor would never have allowed her target to live as long as you did. Whatever your motives might have been, honor was not among them.

v.m: New guy, huh? Ain't seen you around here before. What can I getcha?
v.f: New gal, huh? Ain't seen you around here before. What can I getcha?

v.m: What can I do for ya, new guy?
v.f: What can I do for ya, new gal?

v.human: Compared to me, *every* human is a beanpole. Ain't a bad thing. It's just the way it is.
v.elf: Compared to me, *every* elf is a beanpole. Ain't a bad thing. It's just the way it is.
v.dwarf: Compared to me, *every* dwarf is a beanpole. Ain't a bad thing. It's just the way it is.
v.ork: Compared to me, *every* ork is a beanpole. Ain't a bad thing. It's just the way it is.
v.troll: Compared to me, *every* troll is a beanpole. Ain't a bad thing. It's just the way it is.

v.m: All riiiight! My kind of guy! You've got cram, right? I just *love* a guy that's willing to share...
v.f: All riiiight! My kind of gal! You've got cram, right? I just *love* a gal that's willing to share...

v.m: Come party with me! You've got some cram, right? I just *love* a guy that's willing to share...
v.f: Come party with me! You've got some cram, right? I just *love* a gal that's willing to share...

v.m: Hello... ah, welcome back, sir. What can I do for you?
v.f: Hello... ah, welcome back, ma'am. What can I do for you?

v.m: Thank *you,* sir! Have a great day!
v.f: Thank *you,* ma'am! Have a great day!

v.m: I heard him loud and clear, mop-jockey. Now *you* listen to *me.* Nobody without Delta clearance gets through this door, period. I'd suggest that you talk to management. If you really do need to be in here, they'll upgrade your clearance. Otherwise, piss off.
v.f: I heard her loud and clear, mop-jockey. Now *you* listen to *me.* Nobody without Delta clearance gets through this door, period. I'd suggest that you talk to management. If you really do need to be in here, they'll upgrade your clearance. Otherwise, piss off.

v.m: Sorry to have bothered you, sir. You're cleared to be here, but stay where I can see you, and don't leave this room.
v.f: Sorry to have bothered you, ma'am. You're cleared to be here, but stay where I can see you, and don't leave this room.

v.m: I can't help you, sir. You're cleared to be in this room, but only under direct supervision, and we can't leave our posts to escort you into the other room.
v.f: I can't help you, ma'am. You're cleared to be in this room, but only under direct supervision, and we can't leave our posts to escort you into the other room.

v.m: All right, new guy. What's your name?
v.f: All right, new gal. What's your name?

v.m: Is that the man who has taken over for Monika, Burakgazi?
v.f: Is that the woman who has taken over for Monika, Burakgazi?

v.m: Give him a soykaf! A big one! And put it on my account! I like the cut of his jib.
v.f: Give her a soykaf! A big one! And put it on my account! I like the cut of her jib.

v.m: And a scone! I was going to say, “and a scone as well”! Nothing is too good for him!
v.f: And a scone! I was going to say, “and a scone as well”! Nothing is too good for her!

v.m: Ah, Altuğ, Freund. You are as quick-witted and sharp-tongued as ever. I bow to you.
v.f: Ah, Altuğ, Freundin. You are as quick-witted and sharp-tongued as ever. I bow to you.

v.m: What're you talkin' about, man? We ain't gonna finish nothin'. Those Humanis pukes won't even talk to us without Maxim there.
v.f: What're you talkin' about, woman? We ain't gonna finish nothin'. Those Humanis pukes won't even talk to us without Maxim there.

v.m: He slowly nods.
v.f: She slowly nods.

v.m: He spits on the ground.
v.f: She spits on the ground.

v.m: Too bad for *all* of us, man. We can't finish the trade without Maxim! Those Humanis bastards... they won't even *talk* to anyone else. We're screwed!
v.f: Too bad for *all* of us, woman. We can't finish the trade without Maxim! Those Humanis bastards... they won't even *talk* to anyone else. We're screwed!

v.m: He pulls a flask from his jacket pocket and takes a long swig, then looks you in the eye.
v.f: She pulls a flask from her jacket pocket and takes a long swig, then looks you in the eye.

v.m: He nods.
v.f: She nods.

v.m: Doktor Huitzilin is your *uncle?* I... I had no idea. Please, carry on. Sir.
v.f: Doktor Huitzilin is your *uncle?* I... I had no idea. Please, carry on. Ma'am.

v.m: See that? Your muscle is smarter than you are. You should put him in charge.
v.f: See that? Your muscle is smarter than you are. You should put her in charge.

v.m: Y-yes sir! I... I know who sent you. Please, tell your masters that I won't tell *anyone* that you were here!
v.f: Y-yes ma'am! I... I know who sent you. Please, tell your masters that I won't tell *anyone* that you were here!

v.m: Funny. You're a funny guy.
v.f: Funny. You're a funny gal.

v.m: Sure thing guy.
v.f: Sure thing gal.

v.m: Sure thing guy.
v.f: Sure thing gal.

v.m: A discerning customer, you are. Well, I have many more traditional weapons for a man of your tastes.
v.f: A discerning customer, you are. Well, I have many more traditional weapons for a woman of your tastes.

v.m: He looks fed, for one thing.
v.f: She looks fed, for one thing.

v.m: You there! Maintenance Guy! Stop right where you are.
v.f: You there! Maintenance Gal! Stop right where you are.
